linkedin._comment: Set disabled to false and add your token to enable LinkedIn posting

email._comment: Configure path to email MCP server and enable for email sending

browser._comment: Enable for browser automation (payment portals, web actions)

filesystem._comment: Built-in filesystem access for vault operations

_notes.setup_linkedin:
1. Get LinkedIn API token from https://developer.linkedin.com
2. Replace <your_linkedin_access_token> above
3. Set disabled to false
_notes.setup_email:
1. Install email MCP: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-email
2. Update path above
3. Set disabled to false
_notes.test_mcp: Run: claude --print 'Test MCP connection' to verify
